results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if pipeline/stage IDs unknown)] [Prerequisite]: List deal pipelines/stages using HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_PIPELINES_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE (pick valid pipeline/dealstage; be ready to scan a large response).
[Optional (to avoid duplicates)] [Prerequisite]: Search for an existing similar deal using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_DEALS (reuse if a clear match exists).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Find the target person record using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (capture results[].id).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Find the target organization record using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_COMPANIES (paginate via data.paging.next.after; capture results[].id).
[Optional (if association labels/type IDs are required)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate association types using HUBSPOT_LIST_ASSOCIATION_TYPES (record needed associationTypeId values).
[Required] [Step]: Create the deal using HUBSPOT_CREATE_DEAL (set schema-valid properties incl. pipeline/dealstage; include person/organization associations inline when supported).
[Fallback (if creation fails with validation/schema errors)] [Fallback]: Retry using HUBSPOT_CREATE_DEAL_FROM_NL (keep only clearly valid fields and intended associations).
[Required] [Next Step]: Verify deal↔person and deal↔organization links using HUBSPOT_READ_ASSOCIATIONS_BATCH (treat results as source of truth).

[Optional (if verification shows missing/incorrect links)] [Next Step]: Create/fix links using HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_ASSOCIATION (include associationTypeId when required), then re-check using HUBSPOT_READ_ASSOCIATIONS_BATCH.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_PIPELINES_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE] Pipeline/stage payloads can be very large and may appear truncated; select by id/label and scan/filter rather than expecting a small response.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_COMPANIES] Cursor pagination is common; stop only when data.paging.next.after is absent or matches may be missed.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_DEAL] 400 errors like INVALID_OPTION, INVALID_INTEGER, PROPERTY_DOESNT_EXIST indicate schema/type mismatches; remove or correct offending properties before retry.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Overly strict criteria can return empty results; broaden filters when matches are unexpectedly missing.
[HUBSPOT_READ_ASSOCIATIONS_BATCH] Results may include multiple associationTypes for the same linked record (and direction can vary); treat typeIds as metadata, not duplicate links.

amount.description: Total monetary value of the deal.

examples: New Website Project for Acme Corp
dealname.description: Descriptive name or title of the deal.

pipeline.description: ID of the sales pipeline for this deal (required).

closedate.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime (ISO 8601) when the deal closed or is expected to close.

dealstage.description: Valid pipeline stage ID for the deal. IMPORTANT: Stage IDs must be actual values from your HubSpot pipeline configuration - random values, phone numbers, or placeholder text will be rejected by the API with INVALID_OPTION errors. Stage IDs can be either string-based (e.g., 'closedwon', 'closedlost') or numeric strings (e.g., '2317386479') depending on your pipeline setup. You MUST retrieve valid stage IDs using the Pipelines API (GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals) or from HubSpot Settings > Objects > Deals > Pipelines before setting this field.

description.description: Detailed text description of the deal.

hs_campaign.description: GUID of the HubSpot campaign that generated this deal.

id.description: Numeric ID of the CRM object to associate with (e.g., '12345').

to.description: Represents the target object ID for an association.

associationTypeId.description: Unique ID of the association type, specifying the relationship nature (e.g., deal-contact).

associationCategory.description: A categorization of the association type. The available categories are `HUBSPOT_DEFINED`, `USER_DEFINED`, and `INTEGRATOR_DEFINED`.

items.description: Defines the type of association between CRM objects.

types.description: List of association types to be created, each defining category and type ID.

to__id.description: Numeric ID of the CRM object (e.g., contact, company) to associate with. Must be a numeric string (e.g., '12345'). Alternative to 'to' field - use either 'to_id' OR 'to', not both.

items.description: Specifies associations with other CRM objects.

associations.description: Associations to create between the new deal and other CRM objects (e.g., contact, company).

hs_is_closed.description: Indicates if deal is closed ('true'/'false'; read-only, from deal stage properties).

examples: Schedule follow-up call for next week
hs_next_step.description: Next planned step for this deal.

hs_object_id.description: Unique ID of the deal object (read-only, HubSpot-assigned).

days_to_close.description: Days between creation and close (read-only, HubSpot-calculated).

hs_createdate.description: Specific date/time deal record created (ISO 8601, read-only, HubSpot-set).

hs_all_team_ids.description: Semicolon-separated list of all associated team IDs (owner's primary, additional teams; typically read-only).

hs_all_owner_ids.description: Semicolon-separated list of all owner IDs (primary, co-owners).

hubspot_owner_id.description: ID of the HubSpot user owning the deal; may be auto-assigned if unspecified.

closed_won_reason.description: Reason why the deal was won.

custom_properties.description: Custom properties for the deal. Keys are internal property names (as defined in your HubSpot account), values are the property values to set. CRITICAL: Enum/dropdown properties have STRICT validation - you MUST use exact values from your HubSpot configuration or the API will reject with INVALID_OPTION error. To find valid values: go to HubSpot Settings > Properties > Deals > [Property Name] > Edit > Field Type Options. Requirements by type: (1) Enum/dropdown: case-sensitive exact match required (check your HubSpot property settings for valid options); (2) Number: numeric strings only, no units (e.g., '12' not '12 months'); (3) Date: ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15'); (4) Checkbox: 'true' or 'false'. Properties are account-specific and may not exist in all HubSpot portals. Example: `{'project_type': 'migration', 'priority_level': 'high'}`.

closed_lost_reason.description: Reason why the deal was lost.

deal_currency_code.description: Currency code for deal amount. IMPORTANT: Only currency codes enabled in your HubSpot portal settings are valid. If omitted, defaults to your portal's home currency. To find valid currency codes: go to Settings > Account defaults > Currencies to see your enabled currencies. Common codes include 'USD' and 'EUR', but availability depends on your portal configuration.

hs_analytics_source.description: Original deal source per HubSpot analytics (e.g., 'Organic Search'; typically read-only).

hs_lastmodifieddate.description: Date/time deal last modified (ISO 8601, read-only, HubSpot-updated).

hs_projected_amount.description: Projected deal amount (manually set or calculated).

amount_in_home_currency.description: Deal's value in company's home currency (read-only, HubSpot-calculated).

hs_forecast_probability.description: Sales forecasting probability; may differ from 'hs_deal_stage_probability'.

hs_deal_stage_probability.description: Win probability (decimal, e.g., 0.5) based on current stage; typically stage-defined.

hs_all_accessible_team_ids.description: Semicolon-separated list of team IDs with access (typically read-only).

engagements_last_meeting_booked.description: Date/time of last booked meeting for this deal (typically read-only).

hs_all_assigned_business_unit_ids.description: Semicolon-separated list of assigned business unit IDs (for Business Units add-on).

engagements_last_meeting_booked_medium.description: Medium (e.g., 'Meetings') of last booked meeting (typically read-only).

engagements_last_meeting_booked_source.description: Source (e.g., 'Calendar') of last booked meeting (typically read-only).

engagements_last_meeting_booked_campaign.description: Campaign ID for the last booked meeting (typically read-only).

HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_ASSOCIATION.description: Tool to create or label an association between two CRM records using HubSpot Associations v4 API. Use when you need to link records (e.g., contact to company, deal to contact) with explicit association labels.

associationTypeId.description: The numeric type ID for this association label. IMPORTANT: Association type IDs are specific to each object type combination and direction. Common examples: Contact→Company (1=primary, 279=unlabeled), Company→Contact (2=primary, 280=unlabeled), Company→Company (450=company_to_company, 13=parent_to_child, 14=child_to_parent), Contact→Contact (449), Deal→Contact (3), Deal→Company (5). To find valid IDs for your object types, use the HUBSPOT_LIST_ASSOCIATION_TYPES action. Custom associations use IDs ≥ 100000.

associationCategory.description: Category of the association: HUBSPOT_DEFINED for standard associations, USER_DEFINED for custom user-created associations, or INTEGRATOR_DEFINED for integration-specific associations.

items.description: Association label descriptor with category and type ID.

labels.description: Array of association label descriptors defining the type(s) of relationship between the two records. Each label includes an associationCategory and associationTypeId.

objectId.description: The unique ID of the source CRM record.

objectType.description: The type of the source object (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets', or a custom object type).

toObjectId.description: The unique ID of the target CRM record to associate with.

toObjectType.description: The type of the target object to associate with (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets', or a custom object type).

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_PIPELINES_FOR_SPECI.description: Retrieves all pipelines in HubSpot for a specified CRM object type, such as deals or tickets.

objectType.description: The case-sensitive CRM object type (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets') for which to retrieve pipelines; must support pipelines.

HUBSPOT_LIST_ASSOCIATION_TYPES.description: Lists all valid association types between two specified HubSpot CRM object types.

toObjectType.description: The type of the second object in the association (e.g., contact, company, deal).

fromObjectType.description: The type of the first object in the association (e.g., contact, company, deal).
